definitions: A line or boundary where two objects or forces meet and exert pressure on each other.
In sports, a designated line or area where a ball or player must make contact to be considered in play or to score.
In engineering, a theoretical line representing the point of initial contact between two colliding bodies.
examples: The impact line on the tennis court determined if the shot was in.
Engineers analyzed the impact line to predict material stress.
The artist drew a clear impact line where the two colors met.
